content.headline: Sable Toaster Recall Rumors Debunked by Officials
content.body: Amid swirling rumors, officials confirm that no safety recall has been issued for the Sable Toaster. The popular appliance remains on shelves, much to the relief of toast lovers everywhere. Speculation ran wild after a viral post suggested overheating issues, but authorities have since clarified that the product is safe. "We checked with every agency," said a spokesperson, "and there's absolutely no recall." So keep buttering up—your Sable is good to go. The Vantage reached out for comment, but the manufacturer had nothing to add beyond the official stance. For now, it's business as usual in kitchens across the nation.
